version: OMEGA v1.0 (2026-10-21): BF-02 gas-flow model v0.4 ring counter-current, calibrated Dec 2025 - Oct 2026

kinetics.note: r_m = ln(1-RI_m)/ln(1-RI_sinter) x (d_test/d_m)^n; RI: sinter plant mean (SP-02), others literature (no plant RI for pellets and lump ores); as-charged Sauter sizes from plant sieves

surrogate.note: quadratic in 15 standardised inputs; outputs f1..f6, o1..o6, t1..t6 (h); DOE 520 states

posterior.note: daily omega (200 days, Dec 2025 - Oct 2026) on the model blend term and class shares (wet % of ferrous, sinter the reference), AR(1) errors, operation and quality controls; month-effect and trend specifications averaged; tau by restricted marginal likelihood

validation.note: leave-one-month-out CV of the daily omega: no model predicts a new month level; the engine therefore uses the 14-day calibration as the anchor and this model for differences only
